propositions: Core outbound link diffing imports vendor-specific translation (_RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK from adapters.jira), violating canonical shape principle and core neutrality gate AC3.
Link comparison in _diff_links and _existing_jira_links operates on vendor shape (Jira type names, inward/outward direction) rather than canonical relation vocabulary.

SupportsLinks capability must expose two members: map_remote_links (vendor fields→canonical link set with opaque type passenger) and link_payload_for_relation (canonical relation→vendor type+swap) to move translation onto adapter boundary.
ADD dedup must remain direction-agnostic: a local dep matches a remote link of the same vendor type regardless of which side (inward/outward) the target key occupies.
outbound_differ.py must pass SupportsLinks capability into _diff_links so core comparison uses only canonical relations and opaque vendor type passengers.
Extended AST neutrality gate must verify zero adapters.jira imports in outbound_links.py after refactor.
